tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Page ground and the ground of every section. Also the text on a primary button and the cut-out color inside cover blocks.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Headings, brand, active nav and the fill of the primary button; on ink and on panel. Dark theme 17.1:1, light theme 16.4:1. In the light theme this token is near-black: it names the role, not the hue.

tokens.name: text2
tokens.usage: Body copy and ledes on ink, panel and panel-strong. 13.5:1 dark, 11.8:1 light.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink and panel: labels, captions, bullet text, footer. 7.9:1 dark, 5.6:1 light, so keep it at 10px or larger and never lighter.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Lead accent. Eyebrows, the italic line of a headline, bullet rules, hover titles, focus ring, active nav underline. Text on ink 9.3:1 dark, 5.2:1 light. Use on ink or panel, not over bright wave lines.

tokens.name: sapphire
tokens.usage: Second accent for marks and the second half of the wave and graph. As text on ink it is 5.9:1 dark and 7.7:1 light, but the page uses it for non-text accents only.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Reserved navy that matches the owner's document accent. Defined in the page but not yet used in its CSS.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: panel edges, dividers, tag borders, grid lines. About 1.4:1, so never the only boundary of something clickable.

tokens.name: ctl
tokens.usage: Outline of anything clickable: secondary button, theme toggle. At least 3:1 on ink and panel in both themes (4.4:1 dark, 3.7:1 light).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Frosted plate behind content that sits over the WebGL canvas. Always paired with blur from panel-blur and a line border.

tokens.name: panel-strong
tokens.usage: Denser plate for small cards that need more separation from the canvas, such as interest cards.

tokens.name: panel-soft
tokens.usage: Light plate behind controls: secondary button, theme toggle, progress pill.

tokens.name: panel-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of interest cards.

tokens.name: tint-1
tokens.usage: Amber wash behind a hovered project row.

tokens.name: tint-2
tokens.usage: Fill of the cursor ring when it is over something clickable.

tokens.name: veil-edge
tokens.usage: Outer edge of the vignette laid over the canvas.

tokens.name: head-from
tokens.usage: Top of the header fade.

tokens.name: head-to
tokens.usage: Bottom of the header fade (transparent).

tokens.name: footer-bg
tokens.usage: Footer background.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Custom cursor ring border.

tokens.name: sep
tokens.usage: Dots between nav links.

tokens.name: chip-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of tags and chips.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: scene-amber
tokens.usage: WebGL only: warm node, mote and edge color. Lighter in dark (additive glow), deeper in light (normal blending).

tokens.name: scene-blue
tokens.usage: WebGL only: cool node, mote and edge color.

tokens.name: scene-warm
tokens.usage: WebGL only: inner nodes and traveling pulses.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Hero headline. Fluid: clamp(50px, 8.4vw, 128px). Second line in italic amber.

styles.name: hero-title-accent
styles.usage: The italic accent line under hero-title, colored amber.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Heading of work, stack and interests. Fluid: clamp(40px, 5.6vw, 84px).

styles.name: about-title
styles.usage: Heading inside the about panel. Fluid: clamp(38px, 4.8vw, 70px).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I build agentic pipelines and edge AI.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under the hero title, in text2, max 520px wide.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta values, facts, thread lines under interest cards.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase amber label above a section title. Uppercase is applied in CSS.

styles.name: meta-label
styles.usage: Uppercase mute label above a meta value. 10px is the floor.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav links, uppercase, mute by default and bone when active.

tokens.name: edge-max
tokens.usage: Inset of the five vertical grid lines on wide screens. Fluid: clamp(10px, 2.8vw, 40px).

tokens.name: pad-max
tokens.usage: Content inset from the viewport on wide screens. Fluid: clamp(24px, 5.2vw, 76px).

tokens.name: pad-min
tokens.usage: Content inset on phones.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the content column. Header and progress pill align to it.

tokens.name: header-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the header.

tokens.name: panel-pad
tokens.usage: Inner padding of panels (project rows 38px 36px, stack 38px, about 42px).

tokens.name: panel-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between columns inside a project row.

tokens.name: control-size
tokens.usage: Width and height of the round theme toggle.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panels, work list, interest cards. Square on purpose.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Project tags.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Stack chips.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the progress pill.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Theme toggle, cursor, dots.

tokens.name: row-bar
tokens.usage: Amber bar on the left of a hovered project row.

tokens.name: dot-glow
tokens.usage: Glow on the live-clock dot. The only glow in the interface.

tokens.name: panel-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind every panel.

tokens.name: control-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind buttons, toggle and progress pill.

tokens.name: z-canvas
tokens.usage: WebGL canvas.

tokens.name: z-veil
tokens.usage: Vignette over the canvas.

tokens.name: z-grid
tokens.usage: Vertical hairline grid.

tokens.name: z-main
tokens.usage: Page content.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: Progress pill.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Header.

tokens.name: z-progress
tokens.usage: Scroll progress bar.

tokens.name: z-cursor
tokens.usage: Custom cursor.
